expectations.text: A file matching docs/decisions/NNN-*.md is created (3-digit zero-padded number)
The decision file contains Context, Decision, and Alternatives considered sections
expectations.evidence: File has ## Context, ## Decision, ## Alternatives considered, ## Consequences sections

expectations.text: The alternatives section names at least one approach that was NOT chosen
expectations.evidence: Lists 3 alternatives: new on-disk cache, tuning FastF1 cache/throttling, manual dict cache

expectations.text: The numbering starts at 001 since docs/decisions/ was empty beforehand
data_loader.py is actually modified to add caching (the code change happens, not just the log)
expectations.evidence: Added _memoize lru_cache decorator applied to loader functions
